name: Haiku global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Emerging market recovery positioning via Chinese tech leaders (TCEHY, BABA) and emerging markets ETF, combined with semiconductor infrastructure plays (ASML, TSM, ARM) poised to benefit from ongoing AI capex buildout. Complemented by developed-market quality companies (SAP, NVO, NFLX) and international diversification through regional ETFs. The portfolio leverages geographic diversification and sector exposure uncorrelated with S&P 500 concentration.
